blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Ratio represents a quantitative comparison between two quantities of the same kind and unit.
A proportion expresses the equality of two ratios (a:b = c:d).
Fractional ratios are simplified by multiplying each term by the LCM of their denominators.
Compound ratio is formed by multiplying the corresponding antecedents and consequents of given ratios.
Distribution problems involve dividing a total quantity among individuals according to specified ratio proportions.
A ratio is a comparison of two quantities of the same kind.

Ratio of a and b = a : b

Example:

Ratio of 10 and 20 = 10 : 20 = 1 : 2
When two ratios are equal, they form a proportion.

a : b = c : d

This can also be written as:

a × d = b × c

In SSC examination, questions from this topic are:

• Direct

• Formula-based

• Mostly numerical

blocks.content:
• Ratio has no unit.

• Both terms must be of the same unit.

• Ratio can be simplified like fractions.

• Ratio remains same if both terms are multiplied or divided by the same number.

Example 1:

Find the ratio of 45 minutes to 1.5 hours.

Solution:

1.5 hours = 90 minutes

45 : 90 = 1 : 2

Answer: 1 : 2

If a : b = c : d, then:

a × d = b × c

rows: Extreme terms product = Mean terms product (a·d = b·c)
Product of Antecedents : Product of Consequents

blocks.content: Compound ratio is the ratio obtained by multiplying corresponding terms of two or more ratios.

Example 5:

Divide ₹600 between A and B in the ratio 2 : 3.

Solution:

Total parts = 2 + 3 = 5

A’s share = (2/5) × 600 = 240

B’s share = (3/5) × 600 = 360

Answer: A = ₹240, B = ₹360

• Convert all quantities to the same unit.

• Simplify ratios to lowest form.

• Use proportion formula carefully.

• Ratio questions are often combined with percentage.

items: In any proportion a:b = c:d, Product of Extremes equals Product of Means (a × d = b × c).
Mean proportional between two positive numbers 'a' and 'b' is given by √(a × b).
Third proportional to 'a' and 'b' is calculated as b²/a.
Compound ratio of (a:b) and (c:d) is (a × c) : (b × d).

blocks.content:
Example 6:

The ratio of boys to girls in a class is 3 : 2. If there are 30 boys, find the number of girls.

Solution:

3 : 2 = 30 : x

x = 20

Answer: 20



Example 7:

If a : b = 5 : 7 and b : c = 14 : 15, find a : c.

Solution:

a : b = 10 : 14

b : c = 14 : 15

a : c = 10 : 15 = 2 : 3

Answer: 2 : 3
